name: @aiti-ai/aiti-attach-agent
description: ; supports full automation via environment variables (PI_WEB_BRIDGE_AUTO=1 auto-bridges any CLI session); followUp queue echo + image attachment passthrough + idle time

descriptionI18n.zh-CN: Socket 附着已运行 agent 进程 —— 连接 pi TUI bridge；支持环境变量全自动（PI_WEB_BRIDGE_AUTO=1 任何 CLI 会话自动上桥）；followUp 排队回显 + 图片附件透传 + 空闲超时退出

soul: 不抢方向盘——agent 已经在跑，附着上去看就好。

soulI18n.en: Don't grab the steering wheel — the agent is already running; attach to it and watch.
